title: Wasser-, Kristall- und Flugmobs, Nightmare, Mothra, Inseln
goal: Water and Crystal mobs, the Terrors, Nightmare in five sizes, Mothra, CaterKiller with Brutalfly, the floating islands with Triffid (docs/catalog/README.md section 4.9). Read the hand-off notes docs/port/W01.md up to W07.md first (W06/W07 entity/ai legacy goal ports, LegacyEntityMob.isValidLightLevel, spawn predicate pattern, registration pattern). Apply DECISIONS R20 (NoStepTrigger where the original canTriggerWalking returns false; Mth.floor for coordinate casts) and the W04 XP lesson (1.7.10 EntityAnimal.getExperiencePoints returns 1 + rand.nextInt(3) regardless of experienceValue - check each entity's base class before porting XP). ENTITY PORTER CONTRACT for every entity in this wave: (1) the entity class with the original class name, attributes from the manifest/MobStats at runtime, SynchedEntityData for every DataWatcher index, NBT save/load, AI goals in original priority order, custom movement/physics in customServerAiStep in original order, drops as Java in dropCustomDeathLoot (R10), sounds via ModSounds (namespace-less sounds stay silent, R18), XP, despawn rules, spawn placement predicate ported from getCanSpawnHere, registration via registry_entries (natural biome spawns are W12); (2) EntityType registration with the manifest id, MobCategory per R9/R18, hitbox from the manifest size (runtime rescale via getDefaultDimensions + refreshDimensions, R9), tracking range per R9 - via registry_entries; (3) attribute creation via registry_entries; (4) the model class <Name>Model in client/model/ baking the generated <Name>Geometry (never edit geometry) with setupAnim ported from the original render()/setRotationAngles() per R8, translucent/GL passes per docs/research/06-models-design.md; (5) the renderer with scale() from preRenderCallback (PitchBlack and Crab scale at runtime), texture variants via getTextureLocation, shadow size; renderer + layer registration via registry_entries; (6) the spawn egg per entity (manifest kind spawn_egg) with the W01 generic spawn egg class via registry_entries and its item model. Water mobs drying out on land use setHealth where heal ignores negative amounts (R18, catalogue 6.3). Back-edges: grep 'TODO W08', fill in owned files, report the rest via registry_entries.
